mentions.name: Webfrolic
mentions.description: Identity, security, and access platform architected to combine workforce identity, customer identity, fine-grained authorization, an IT service desk, and a customer support desk — comparable to Okta plus Auth0 plus Authzed plus ServiceNow plus Zendesk. Work in progress: settling how AI agent needs fit into the architecture while avoiding security and performance foot guns from administrator configuration, and running feature stress testing and performance testing.
mentions.problem: Gaps between specs vs implementation and between asks vs real needs in the identity, security, and access space, based on a couple of decades of enterprise experience.
mentions.source_excerpt: Consider Okta (Workforce identity)+ Auth0 (Customer Identity), Authzed (authorization) + ServiceNow (IT service Desk) + Zendesk (Customer Support Desk) architected together
